work_dir.description: Directory where MRTG stores generated HTML pages, graphs (PNGs), and log files. Must be writable by the MRTG user.

default_snmp_community.description: Default SNMP community string used for devices that don’t specify one in their Target line. Avoid 'public' in production for security.

default_snmp_version.description: Default SNMP version (1, 2c, or 3) for targets without explicit version. '2c' is most common for legacy monitoring.

default_snmp_authname.description: SNMPv3 authentication username (used only if SNMPv3 is enabled). Leave blank if not using SNMPv3.

default_snmp_authpass.description: SNMPv3 authentication password. Required if SNMPv3 is enabled with auth (noAuthNoPriv or authNoPriv).

default_snmp_privpass.description: SNMPv3 privacy (encryption) password. Required if using authPriv (authentication + encryption).

default_snmp_authproto.description: SNMPv3 authentication protocol: 'md5' or 'sha'. 'sha' is more secure, but older devices may require 'md5'.

default_snmp_privproto.description: SNMPv3 privacy protocol: 'des' or 'aes'. 'aes' is preferred for security; 'des' is legacy.

interval.description: Polling interval in seconds. Standard is 300 (5 minutes). Must match cron/daemon schedule to avoid gaps or double-sampling.

log_errors.description: If true, write errors to stderr (helpful during initial setup or troubleshooting).

log_syslog.description: If true, send log messages to syslog (e.g., for centralized logging).

enable_fast_refresh.description: If true, enables fast refresh — avoids reprocessing unchanged data, reducing CPU load.

compress_logs.description: If true, compress old log files to save disk space (uses gzip).

generate_pngs.description: If true, generate PNG graph files in addition to HTML and logs. Set to false for log-only mode.

generate_index.description: If true, generate HTML index pages to summarize monitored targets.

debug.description: If true, enable verbose debug logging (very verbose — only for troubleshooting).

html_title.description: Title shown on MRTG HTML pages (e.g., 'Network Traffic – Datacenter A').

mrtg_bin.description: Absolute path to the MRTG binary (if installed nonstandard). Usually left as default.

use_24_hour_time.description: If true, use 24-hour format in timestamps; otherwise uses 12-hour (AM/PM).

use_timezone.description: Timezone for timestamps (e.g., 'UTC', 'America/New_York'). Avoid 'local' in distributed environments.

daemon_mode.description: If true, run MRTG as a long-lived daemon (polls on schedule). Recommended for high-frequency or many targets. If false, use cron.

write_pid_file.description: Path to PID file if daemon_mode=true. Required for service management (e.g., stop/start/restart).

name.description: Unique identifier for this target (e.g., 'router1_eth0'). Used in HTML/Graph filenames.

label.description: Human-readable label for the target (used in logs and HTML).

spec.description: SNMP specification: OID(s) and host/community in format 'oid:community@host' or 'router@host'.

description.description: Optional description (comment only). Helps document what the target monitors.

router.description: Optional 'router' hostname for routing/aliasing (used by tools like indexmaker).

snmp_community.description: Override the default SNMP community string for this target (e.g., 'private').

max_bits.description: Maximum expected throughput in bits/second (for Y-axis scaling). Set 0 to auto-scale.

traffic_unit.description: Unit for display: 'bytes', 'bits', 'packets', or 'errors'. Affects scaling labels.

options.description: List of MRTG options (comma-separated in config). Common: 'gauge' for counters, 'perminute' to scale to per-minute, 'nosmooth' to disable smoothing.

title.description: HTML <title> for this target’s page (overrides global html_title).

page_top.description:
